parsed.explanation: If outed, a trans visitor faces state criminalisation of visibility itself: depictions/presence classed as pornography/non-traditional relations, up to 4 years imprisonment under Article 343, and 13 years where children are involved. Documented September 2024 detentions of 8 trans people, beatings during arrest, coerced hooliganism/pornography charges and custody abuse show enforcement, not just paper law. Police collect photos/data, do not register brutality, prisons encourage abuse, no anti-discrimination/hate-crime protection or regional court recourse. State propaganda equates trans identity with paedophilia and foreign threat. No execution for this offence is documented, placing it above 0.05 but well below 0.25.

entry_documents.exposure: Foreign visitors exposed to same machinery; 2004 threats of expulsion for foreigners attending LGBT workshops. Border acceptance of foreign documents: uncertain.
entry_documents.interaction: Document/presentation mismatch can trigger pornography/propaganda investigation, detention and expulsion.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: 15+ LGBTQ detained in Sep 2024, 8 trans; beatings on arrest, coerced charges, physical/psychological custody abuse; prisons encourage abuse, blackmail/extortion.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented. No consular, legal-aid or independent oversight remedy documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest for hooliganism/pornography leads to custody where abuse is tolerated, deterring complaints.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Not documented. No facilities, bathroom, ward or custody-placement rules for visitors are described.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Not documented. Unknown whether detention placement follows birth sex or presentation.

care_services.exposure: Qualified psychological help generally unavailable; no trans-specific facilities documented. HRT/medication rules not documented.
care_services.interaction: Scarce care compounds custody and detention harm; no documented visitor care protection.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: 2024 pornography redefinition and decree grouping homosexualism with paedophilia/necrophilia; Apr 2026 propaganda ban includes gender reassignment; TV equates LGBTI with paedophilia/foreign weapon.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Not documented. No anti-discrimination or hate-crime law.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat-framing licenses police detention, venue raids/closures and public hostility.

minors_guardians.exposure: Offence rises to 13 years where children involved; propaganda law expressly targets child-related framing. Travelling with a minor greatly raises escalation risk if presence/depiction is charged.
minors_guardians.interaction: Adult-minor travel increases risk that authorities frame the case as child-involved, while no guardian protections are documented.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: 84% hostile poll 2017; open LGBT people face harassment/violence; police collect data/photos at cruising areas and raided bars/venues; victims have little expectation of redress.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Not documented. Police do not register brutality or investigate homophobic motives; no hate-crime data since 2015.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Public hostility plus police non-protection and active profiling makes street risk state-amplified.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No regional human-rights court access, no SOGI asylum/protection, partners not recognised for immigration; courts/oversight remedy not documented.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Absence of recourse means detention, extortion and violence are unremedied; detention/abuse figures rest on NGO reporting without official confirmation.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than this case: 0.05 requires documented execution pathway; here death penalty is retained generally but no capital prosecution for trans depiction/presence is documented, and statutory maximum is 4 years (13 with children).

Similar to this case: criminalisation of presentation, routine arrest, custody beatings, deferential/no remedy. This case is slightly higher because capital provision for presentation is not documented and sentences are capped at 4 years for the core offence.

Lower than this case: 0.25 involves raids/fines/short detention with imprisonment rare and courts overturning some convictions; here imprisonment is statutory, arrests are documented with beatings/coerced charges, and no effective court remedy is documented.
Materially lower: 0.35 involves stops, hours-long detention and fines but detention rarely becomes imprisonment; here prosecution under a 4-year pornography law and custody abuse are documented.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime is one hostile system: national criminalisation of trans visibility/propaganda, immediate police enforcement with beatings and coerced charges, custody and prison abuse, data collection without investigation of anti-LGBT violence, and state media threat-framing. No operative protection at entry, in custody, in care or through courts offsets these exposures. The absence of a documented execution pathway for this offence keeps the rating above 0.05-0.15 extremes, but statutory imprisonment plus documented abuse and zero recourse place it in Severe Risk, especially for visitors travelling with minors.
